description: The camera stands on the Via Sacra in the late afternoon, looking west through the Roman Forum. On the left the Basilica Julia is a low ruined platform of column stumps, with no standing colonnade. In the center distance the Arch of Septimius Severus shows its triple archway, one large opening and two smaller side openings. On the right the Temple of Saturn stands on its podium as an eight-column porch with Ionic capitals. Umbrella pines crown the Palatine behind. The modelled scenario is 30 September 2026 at 16:23 Europe/Rome: clear, 26.7°C, cloud cover 1 percent, bright afternoon daylight, not a verified on-site observation.
